plan_amendments: Section 9, adopted 2026-10-10 before any held-out label, class count, or metric was inspected
split_identity: GlucoBench DataFormatter split seed 0; aggregate counts and provenance in paper/results/split_audit.json

observation_mask.primary: no-gap-fill: every grid value lies on or between two original readings at most 7.5 minutes apart (Amendment 1)

calibration.nested_budgets: the 200-window set is the first 200 of the 1,000-window ordering
calibration.pool: eligible validation windows under the primary mask; no future labels used by any sampler

artifacts.note: 100 from the Section 3 matrix plus 10 from the observer arm; bundled application models are never overwritten

primary_endpoint: minority_macro_recall(range_coverage_200) - minority_macro_recall(participant_balanced_random_200), observed-only held-out-participant component, paired by model seed, calibration draw, and evaluated windows
secondary_contrasts: uniform_random vs sequential at each budget (Amendment 2)

uncertainty.undefined_endpoint_rule: report metric as undefined on zero support; omit interval if more than 5% of bootstrap draws are undefined

baselines: multinomial logistic regression, C=1, balanced weights
device_workload: Section 5 of the plan: nine artifacts (seed 0, draw 101), 30 paired rounds, 100 warm-up + 200 timed calls per artifact per round, frozen synthetic trace

storage.local: results/calibration-coverage/<run-id>/ (gitignored): checkpoints, per-window outputs, selected window keys, participant-level summaries
storage.published: paper/results/calibration-coverage/: aggregate reports and reproducibility metadata only
